items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: the only thing about this is Petrello and Gray were holding hands.

ctx.x: Well, your band at the Delisa was -- had some white musicians in it occasionally.
Oh, yeah, but that was fine. But, see, the only thing about this is Petrello and Gray were holding hands.
Well, that was always the story, that they had an agreement.
